meta.title: Help - frequently asked questions
meta.description: Have questions or need help? Check out the frequently asked questions or contact our support team. We're here to help you!

moreQuestions.title: Have more questions?
moreQuestions.subtitle: Describe your case to get the most accurate assistance.

content.question: How do I create an account?
content.answer: To create an account, click the 'Try for free' button on the homepage. You can register using your email address or sign in with Google, Facebook, or GitHub.

content.question: Do I need to activate my account after registration?
content.answer: Yes, if you register using your email, you'll receive a message with an activation link. Click it to activate your account and gain access to the platform.

content.question: What are the password requirements?
content.answer: Your password must be at least 8 characters long, including one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one special character (e.g., !, @, #).

content.question: How can I change my password?
content.answer: If you log in with email and password, you can change your password in the 'Account settings' → 'Manage account' section.

content.question: I forgot my password – what should I do?
content.answer: On the login page, click 'Forgot password?'. Enter your email address, and you'll receive a message with a link to reset your password.

content.question: How do I change my personal information?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Personal information' to edit your first name, last name, or other profile details.

content.question: Where can I check or change my plan?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Subscription' to view your current plan and switch to another.

content.question: How do I delete my account?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Manage account'. You'll find the option to delete your account there.

content.question: How do projects work on the platform?
content.answer: Projects consist of interactive stages you can complete at your own pace. They are not live classes—you work whenever you want.

content.question: Do I need to install additional software?
content.answer: Yes. You code projects on your own computer, so you need a code editor (e.g., VS Code) and any tools required for the technologies used in the project.

content.question: Can I pause a project and come back later?
content.answer: Yes. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can return to the project anytime.

content.question: Will I get a certificate after completing a project?
content.answer: Yes. After finishing a project on the Basic or Premium plan, you'll receive a certificate that you can download or share.

content.question: Is access to projects time-limited?
content.answer: No. Once you purchase access, you have unlimited time to use the materials within your plan.

content.question: Can I use projects on my phone?
content.answer: Yes, our platform works on mobile devices too. For the best experience, we recommend using a computer.

content.question: Will I receive a certificate after completing a project?
content.answer: Yes, after completing a project on the Basic or Premium plan, you'll get a personalized certificate in PDF or PNG format.

content.question: Is the certificate available immediately after completing the project?
content.answer: Yes, the certificate is generated automatically after finishing all stages. You can download it directly from the platform.

content.question: What does the certificate look like?
content.answer: The certificate includes your name, project title, completion date, and a signature from our Loop programming school. You can add it to your CV or LinkedIn profile.

content.question: Can I get a certificate if I'm on the free plan?
content.answer: No. Certificates are only available for users with an active Basic or Premium plan.

content.question: Does the certificate have a unique identification number?
content.answer: Yes, every certificate has a unique ID number that allows verification.

content.question: Are certificates recognized by employers?
content.answer: Certificates prove project completion and practical skills gained. Many users include them in their portfolios or LinkedIn profiles as proof of learning.

content.question: How do I earn points on the platform?
content.answer: You earn points by completing stages and entire projects.

content.question: What are points used for?
content.answer: Points show your progress and engagement with projects.

content.question: Do points affect the certificate?
content.answer: No. You receive a certificate after completing the entire project, regardless of how many points you've earned. Points are proof of active learning.

content.question: Can I lose points I've earned?
content.answer: No, points earned during your work stay on your account and do not expire.

content.question: Where can I check my points?
content.answer: Your current points total is visible on your dashboard.

content.question: What payment methods are available?
content.answer: We accept payments by credit card (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), as well as Google Pay and Apple Pay. All payments are processed through Stripe – a global and secure payment provider.

content.question: Is the payment one-time or recurring?
content.answer: Our plans work on a subscription basis – payments renew automatically monthly or yearly unless you cancel your subscription.

content.question: Can I pay using Google Pay or Apple Pay?
content.answer: Yes, Stripe supports both Google Pay and Apple Pay – you can use them when paying on our platform.

content.question: Will I receive an invoice for my subscription?
content.answer: Yes, after each payment, you’ll receive an invoice you can download from your account settings under 'Payments'.

content.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
content.answer: You can cancel your subscription anytime in account settings under 'Subscription'. After cancellation, access to projects remains active until the end of the current billing period.

content.question: Are my payment details secure?
content.answer: Yes, we use Stripe – one of the safest payment platforms worldwide. Your card data is not stored on our servers.

content.question: Do you offer a free trial period?
content.answer: Every user can start for free with the free plan, which gives access to one stage of each project. It's a great chance to test the platform before switching to a paid plan.

content.question: What should I do if my payment was declined?
content.answer: Make sure your card is active and has sufficient funds. You can also try another payment method (e.g., Google Pay). If problems persist, contact our support team.
